meta_description: Tyneandwear Firewood & Garden Services in Newcastle. Expert garden maintenance, landscaping, and quality firewood delivery across Tyne and Wear.
hero_eyebrow: Local Family Business — Quality Garden Care & Firewood
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to winter logs delivered to your door, we handle every job with care and attention to detail.
services_heading: Complete Garden & Firewood Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether you need seasonal garden work, landscape design, or premium seasoned firewood, we've got you covered.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Tidying
services.desc: Hedge trimming, border clearance, and seasonal pruning keep your garden looking sharp year-round. We haul away all waste, leaving your space clean and ready to enjoy.

services.title: Firewood Supply & Delivery
services.desc: Seasoned hardwood and softwood logs, stacked and delivered to your door. All wood is kiln-dried, ready to burn, and cut to your preferred length.

services.title: Landscape Design & Build
services.desc: Patios, raised beds, pathways, and planting schemes tailored to your taste and budget. We handle groundworks, materials sourcing, and project management from start to finish.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Felling
services.desc: Safe removal, sectional felling, and stump grinding for trees of all sizes. We're fully insured and leave your garden tidy and ready for new planting.

services.title: Lawn Care & Seeding
services.desc: Aeration, scarification, feeding, and seed laying restore tired lawns to lush green health. Monthly or seasonal packages available.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Waste Removal
services.desc: Heavy-duty clearance of overgrown sites, rubble, and garden waste. We recycle and dispose responsibly, leaving you with a blank canvas to work with.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it's our own — honest work, fair prices, no fuss.
about_para_1: Tyneandwear Firewood & Garden Services started over a decade ago when our founder grew tired of seeing local gardeners cut corners and overcharge. We built the business on a simple promise: show up on time, do quality work, and charge fairly. Today we're the go-to team for garden maintenance, landscaping, and firewood right across Newcastle and the wider Tyne and Wear area.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on repeat customers and personal recommendations. We listen to what you want, explain options clearly, and deliver results that last. Whether it's a one-off tidy or a complete garden overhaul, we bring the same attention to detail and friendly professionalism every single time.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant lads. Came in, assessed the whole mess we'd let the garden become, gave a fair quote on the spot, and were back a week later with a mini digger and a plan. Cleared three years of overgrowth, laid new borders, and took everything away. Looks like a proper garden again. Will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Ordered two loads of firewood for the winter. Delivered on the day promised, stacked neatly, and actually seasoned properly — not like the soggy logs I tried last year. Burns beautifully. Fair price too. Will order again next autumn.
reviews.author: Jennifer K.

reviews.text: Had them design and build a new patio and raised veg beds. Took them about a fortnight, kept the site tidy, and they explained every step. Finished product is exactly what we'd talked about. Would recommend them in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: David M.
